title: Ngeli ya LI-LI (Theme 7: Matunda na mimea)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child knows the few LI-LI nouns (jua, giza, tunda as a crop of one) keep li- with no plural form.
representations: a picture of the sun and the dark
a LI-YA and LI-LI side by side
steps: Ask: does it have a ma- plural?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Giza limeingia" and explains why it has no plural.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Jua ___metoka asubuhi." Kwa nini "ya" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jua na giza ni nomino za ngeli ya LI-LI: kiambishi ni li-: jua limetoka, giza limeingia.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Giza ___meingia haraka." Kwa nini "u" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jua na giza ni LI-LI: vinatumia li-.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya LI-LI?" Kwa nini "mti" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kati ya nomino hizi, jua na giza ndizo za LI-LI. Mti uko U-I.
Nomino za LI-LI hazibadiliki katika wingi: jua limewaka.
